name: offer-desk.setpoint-read
purpose: Read Offer Desk's ledger-account coverage, financial posture, meter coverage, obligation confidence and outcome-linked learning; retain unmeasured rows as declared gaps.
assumptions: Targets are operator-authored elsewhere; this board never derives a target from a current reading.
money-ledger owns the actuals the board reports as available or unreachable.
invariants: Every row carries reading, target, in_band, unavailable and reason.
A permanent-reason row never lowers the board's status.
An unread sensor is null with a reason; it is never reported as zero.

bindings.note: Optional: an unread sensor becomes a row with a reason; the board still reports.
Optional: an unread sensor becomes a row with a reason; the board still reports.
Optional: an unread sensor becomes a row with a reason; the board still reports.

signals.rows: ledger-account-coverage, default-alive-posture, meter-coverage, obligation-confidence, learning, external-friction, catalog-conformance, promotion-latency; each has reading, target, in_band, unavailable and reason.

outputs.evidence: The sensor binding ids that answered.

fixtures.note: Partial only when a sensor read is transiently unreachable; the three permanent-reason rows do not lower status.
